_note: APIs that were considered or previously included, then removed. Don't re-add without a clear explanation of what changed.

graveyard.name: Bored API
graveyard.reason: DNS no longer resolves — service appears shut down some time after 2024.

graveyard.name: Quotable
graveyard.reason: DNS no longer resolves — service offline. Replaced in entertainment by Advice Slip + ZenQuotes.

graveyard.name: CoinCap
graveyard.reason: DNS no longer resolves at v2; CoinPaprika fills the same niche.

graveyard.name: Public APIs API
graveyard.reason: Defunct — DNS no longer resolves. The whole point of APIShelf is to replace this.

graveyard.name: World Bank Open Data API
graveyard.reason: Cloudflare 524 timeouts during verification — too unreliable to recommend right now. Re-evaluate in a future health-check pass.

graveyard.name: Binance public ticker
graveyard.reason: Returns HTTP 451 from US IPs — geo-restricted, can't be recommended as a US-friendly free API.

graveyard.name: LibreTranslate (libretranslate.com mirror)
graveyard.reason: Public mirror now requires an API key. Self-hosting still works but isn't a hosted free option.
